author: Ari Koslow
title: Emerson Hancock leaves start early Sunday
desc: Emerson Hancock was removed from Sunday's start early against the Rays with an apparent injury.
impact: Hancock was struck in the hand by a comebacker in the first inning. He remained in the game, but he was later removed in the second inning. There should be an update on his status when available.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitch Bratt recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Diamondbacks recalled RHP Mitch Bratt from Triple-A Reno.
impact: Bratt draws the start on Sunday with Zac Gallen headed to the injured list. He made his MLB debut earlier this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zac Gallen (elbow) placed on IL
desc: The Diamondbacks placed RHP Zac Gallen on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation.
impact: It was reported on Saturday that Gallen was scratched from Sunday's start and expected to be placed on the injured list. It is now official. He does not hold a timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcus Semien (hip) to begin rehab assignment Sunday
desc: Marcus Semien will begin a rehab assignment at Double-A Binghampton on Sunday.
impact: Semien will use the All-Star break to go on a rehab assignment. He should be activated shortly after the break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andre Granillo activated by Tigers Sunday
desc: The Tigers activated Andre Granillo on Sunday.
impact: Granillo was claimed off of waivers from the Nationals on Saturday. He'll add an extra arm for Detroit on Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Framber Valdez placed on bereavement list
desc: The Tigers placed LHP Framber Valdez on the bereavement list.
impact: Valdez will be away from the team on Sunday. He should be back after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Donovan Walton claimed off waivers by Athletics
desc: The Athletics claimed INF Donovan Walton off waivers from the Angels.
impact: Walton had been designated for assignment by the Angels earlier this week. He will add infield depth for the Athletics.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. goes deep, swipes base in loss to Padres
desc: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. went 2-for-4 in Saturday's loss to the Padres with a three-run home run, one walk, and one stolen base.
impact: Guerrero Jr. has heated up at the plate, driving in runs in each of his last three contests. The first baseman offers manager John Schneider one of the few stable bats in an inconsistent Blue Jays lineup to this point, slashing .265 with six home runs, 41 RBI, 51 runs scored, and seven stolen bases across 90 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dylan Cease to start All-Star game for AL
desc: Dylan Cease will start for the American League in the All-Star game.
impact: Cease will take the mound opposite of Cristopher Sanchez. He is second in all of baseball with 148 strikeouts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Campusano scratched from lineup Sunday
desc: Luis Campusano was scratched from the Padres lineup on Sunday against the Blue Jays.
impact: There should be an update provided on Campusano when available.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ernie Clement chips in hit, steal in loss to Padres
desc: Ernie Clement went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Padres with one walk and one stolen base.
impact: Clement continues a steady stretch at the plate, picking up hits in 11 of his last 15 contests. The second baseman has provided manager John Schneider with one of the few stable bats in an inconsistent Blue Jays lineup, slashing .297 with seven home runs, 30 RBI, 41 runs scored, and three steals through 92 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Trey Yesavage melts down on mound in no-decision
desc: Trey Yesavage allowed four earned runs on one hit and seven walks while striking out one over 1 2/3 innings in Saturday's loss to the Padres.
impact: Yesavage has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three or more runs in five of his last seven trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of many inconsistent arms in the Blue Jays rotation to this point for manager John Schneider, posting a 3.72 ERA and 1.16 WHIP with a 4-4 record and 1.8 K/BB ratio across 14 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Casey Mize labors on mound in loss to Phillies
desc: Casey Mize allowed three earned runs on five hits and two walks while striking out five over 5 2/3 innings in Saturday's 4-2 loss to the Phillies.
impact: Mize continues a solid stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in five of his last eight trips to the mound. The right-hander has offered manager AJ Hinch with another stable option in the Tigers rotation to this point, carrying a 2.79 ERA and 1.00 WHIP with a 4-6 record and 9.0 K/9 ratio across 14 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chase Petty recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Reds recalled Chase Petty from Triple-A Louisville.
impact: Petty will add a fresh arm for the Reds heading into Sunday's final game before the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Lodolo (blister) placed on IL
desc: The Reds placed Nick Lodolo on the 15-day injured list.
impact: Lodolo left his latest start early with a blister. He'll be sidelined for at least the next couple of weeks.
